policies.identity: union checksum-valid singular and observed ORCIDs across all matched works; withhold multiple values globally
policies.malformed: withhold globally on nonempty malformed values or wrong containers; missing/null is allowed
policies.unsupported_organizations: remove organizations without surviving affiliation observations
policies.paper_metadata: preserve all original paper properties; add identity_correction:all_authorships_withheld only when a newly authorless paper lacks a reason
policies.predictions: preserve frozen HAS_TOPIC, taxonomy and all non-derived evidence exactly; no inference

change_ledger.format: full before/after records, edges exclude graph_version only

graph_version_restamp.rule: every surviving edge is restamped; no other unstated changes
